visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair wearing a white lab coat sits behind a desk in a simulated medical office. He points toward a male patient seated opposite him, exhibiting a serious and professional facial expression while speaking emphatically. The background features a medical diagram on the wall and various desktop items like a green notebook and stationary. (2) The scene cuts to a young woman also dressed in a white lab coat, replacing the previous doctor at the same desk. She gestures with her right hand while looking at the patient, her expression firm and inquisitive. The lighting remains bright and even, typical of a studio setting designed to look like a clinic. (3) Another young woman wearing a white coat and glasses is shown at the desk. She leans forward slightly, pointing her finger with an air of authority and diagnostic certainty. A stethoscope is partially visible around her neck, and a medical poster with 'Aspirin' is seen in the background behind her. (4) A second young man in a white lab coat and tie is presented as a different doctor. He looks down at a file on the desk and then back up at the patient, delivering his diagnosis with a calm, analytical demeanor. Behind him, shelves with various medical bottles and containers are clearly visible in the shallow depth of field. (5) The camera focuses on the patient, a young man with a black textured shirt. He looks directly into the lens with a deeply confused and annoyed expression, furrowing his brows as he addresses the viewers. The background shifts slightly to show a blurred office environment as he speaks with exasperation.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 要聽誰的😂. [Logo]: 這群人. [Subtitle]: 你這個是扁桃腺發炎. [Slogan]: 完整版 這群人 減肥的遙遙之路. (2) [Subtitle]: 不是喉嚨太乾. 你上一位醫生給你看錯了. [Slogan]: 醫生不能亂看. (3) [Subtitle]: 扁桃腺發炎? 啊你扁桃腺就沒問題. 這明明就是呼吸道的問題. (4) [Subtitle]: 你這不是呼吸道的問題. 你這是心臟引發的併發症這樣子. 其實也是有呼吸道的問題啊. (5) [Subtitle]: 不過你主要的病因是在心臟這一塊. 心臟引發的併發症? 沒有吧. (6) [Subtitle]: 我看你單純只有腎虛而已. 其他其實沒有什麼問題. 啊對啦, 嘴唇有點太乾, 多擦點護唇膏. (7) [Variety]: 你們才不要亂講耶. [Subtitle]: 什麼? 你剛說什麼? 腎虛有沒有得救? 醫生.
